name: insights_format_terminal
notes: Terminal-report formatter SECTION LADDER. REAL src/agent/insights.c::insights_format_terminal linked via extra_src (with link shims for its db/usage-pricing surface) against LIVE agent/insights.py::InsightsEngine.format_terminal. Input: one scenario JSON per cup; harness materializes it into an insights_report_t, the twin into the report dict LIVE expects. Rung order per input: B empty-report early path; then when non-empty, in order: date-range present / models present / platforms present / tools present / skills present / activity-present (any by_day count>0; inside: hours-present / active_days>0 / max_streak>1) / notable-sessions present — each B followed by a fixed V section marker. AGREED SUB-CONTRACT: value events are fixed section markers because the rendered TEXT is a KNOWN PORT GAP (C prints extra Cache read/write lines, 'User msgs' labels, a Cost column in Models, and %'lld locale grouping that differ from LIVE's literal layout; LIVE's datetime.fromtimestamp is also host-tz dependent while C strftime matches only under the same TZ). LIVE's COST section (estimated/included/unknown buckets) has NO counterpart in the C port — excluded from the ladder entirely; add a rung when the port grows one. Inputs restricted so activity by_day is either absent or carries >=1 nonzero count (LIVE keys the section on list truthiness, C on any count>0 — all-zero lists would diverge).
